reason: The Chat Completions adapter spoke OpenAI's dialect to DeepSeek and Zhipu GLM (Z.ai). Structured output always went out as response_format json_schema, which DeepSeek and Z.ai reject ('This response_format type is unavailable now'), so context compaction failed and every later turn of the conversation failed with it; DeepSeek, Z.ai/BigModel hosts and OpenRouter models whose catalog lacks structured_outputs now get {type: json_object} with 'Return JSON matching this schema: ...' in the instructions, and ContextCompactor._request_memory retries once without response_schema (schema in the instructions) when the provider error names response_format. Vendor finish reasons were stored as complete answers: DeepSeek insufficient_system_resource and Z.ai network_error (and any finish reason that names an error) are now a retryable ProviderOverloadedError, replayed before output in the stream and complete(); Z.ai sensitive is the content filter, raised as #489's ProviderRefusalError like content_filter now is; model_context_window_exceeded is ProviderContextLengthError so compaction recovery runs. strict was sent to every OpenAI-compatible route; it is now sent only to OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry and OpenRouter openai/* ids, keeping #484's _openai_strict_schema guard there. ModelProvider._path inserted /v1 after Z.ai's /api/paas/v4 base (404 on chat and health); a base ending in any version segment now takes no extra /v1. openrouter_model_routes raised on one endpoint with max_completion_tokens null and discarded every endpoint's limits; that endpoint now keeps its own context length as its output cap. test_deepseek_glm_compat.py proves each (33 of its 61 tests fail on main); the edited node ids in test_openai_compatible_parameters.py and test_providers.py pinned the old strict/json_schema behaviour, and the other selected node ids exercise the changed finish-reason, replay, inspector, route-limit and compaction code directly.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite) never talks to DeepSeek, Z.ai or an OpenRouter endpoint catalog; the Python tests drive the adapter, compactor and catalog parser directly. Whole test_providers.py, test_openai_compatible_parameters.py, test_openai_compatible_robustness.py, test_context.py, test_chat.py, test_chat_tool_loop.py and the other provider suites were run locally (all green) and are not selected per the CI-scoping rule. No full suites.
